summary: Bitterroot NF cabin site in Ravalli County, MT: a cabin listed from 1941, abandoned 1950 and now gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1950 per firelookout.com and listed as removed on the Forest Lookouts page; no source read describes the site today

access.note: No source read describes the site today or whether it can be visited

events.note: firelookout.com lists a cabin at the site for 1941; the page does not say the cabin was built that year

evidence.supports: 18 miles south-southwest of West Fork ranger station
evidence.quote: 18 miles SSW of West Fork R.S.

sources.title: Deer Creek Point Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: Two Montana pages only. The 1941 and 1950 dates come from firelookout.com alone; the Forest Lookouts page gives a location code and the word Removed, with no date. Two web searches found no second source. Not used: an Idaho Deer Creek Point page on idaholookouts.weebly.com (not read; a different site) and a 1931 Deer Creek Fire incident on the Kootenai NF, which involved a different lookout. Record kind 'ground' fits the cabin entry. Record has no elevation; firelookout.com gives 8,367 ft. Record coordinates not checked against the distance description.
